title: 信息日报 2026-10-10

headline.title: Deno 加入 Cloudflare
headline.summary: Cloudflare 宣布收购 Deno。Deno 团队此前发布了 celld，这是 Cloudflare Workers 中 Durable Objects 模式的开源实现。收购后，Cloudflare 计划基于 celld 让 workerd 自托管成为构建和运行 Workers 应用的一等支持方式。
headline.summary_en: Cloudflare is acquiring Deno outright. The Deno team had released celld, an open-source implementation of the Durable Objects pattern from Cloudflare Workers. With the acquisition, Cloudflare aims to build on celld to make workerd self-hosting a first-class supported way to build and run applications using the Workers platform.
headline.reason: 这是开发者生态的重大整合，Cloudflare 收购 Deno 可能重塑 JavaScript/TypeScript 运行时与边缘计算格局，社区关注度极高。
headline.reason_en: This is a major consolidation in the developer ecosystem. Cloudflare's acquisition of Deno could reshape the JavaScript/TypeScript runtime and edge computing landscape, and it has drawn intense community attention.
